Use case: product-mockup / brand identity update.
Create a new portrait 2:3 commercial product photography asset for 若水汇 TONER, coherently extending the user's approved water packaging to their existing skincare product.
Image 1 is the OLD toner packaging: preserve its recognizable tall cylindrical bottle silhouette, rounded glass shoulders, thick clear base and cylindrical silver metal screw cap, but completely replace the old 水知源 branding and old droplet/circle logo.
Image 2 is the NEW approved water range: carry over its off-white textured paper label, extremely fine blue-grey crossing mountain/water curves, delicate understated ink landscape at lower third, generous breathing room and elegant Chinese serif typography.
Image 3 is the EXACT NEW logo reference: two crossing slender flowing mountain/water lines and small ring sun. Follow this symbol closely, do not use a droplet icon, circle emblem or unrelated logo.
Image 4 is the finished water packshot style: match its portrait framing, warm ivory seamless background, pale stone tabletop, soft natural upper-left light, restrained shadows and product scale.

Toner bottle contains clear liquid with a subtle mist-blue glass tint, no dramatic splashes or water droplets. Use a matte ivory front label with refined dark blue-grey text. Printed text EXACTLY: brand 若水汇, secondary RUO SHUI HUI, product 爽肤水, secondary TONER. These are the only text elements. No water source locality, no 杭州文旅联名, no unprovided volume, ingredients, certifications or efficacy claims. Preserve skincare identity, do not turn it into a drinking water bottle. Quiet premium Chinese landscape aesthetic, realistic glass, tactile paper, no heading or typography outside the packaging, no props, no website UI.
